purpose: Form ADT-1 is used to give notice to the Registrar about the appointment of an auditor.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Have the appointed auditor submit the required certificate
File the notice of the auditor appointment to the Registrar in Form ADT-1
checklist: Certificate that the individual or firm is eligible and not disqualified for appointment
Certificate that the proposed appointment is as per the term provided under the Act
Certificate that the proposed appointment is within the limits laid down by or under the authority of the Act
True and correct list of proceedings pending against the auditor, audit firm, or any partner regarding professional matters of conduct
